images.seen: First Sealand dynasty is a huge rectangle (42-50 E, 27-32.3 N) over Saudi desert, Kuwait and Khuzestan, where Cliopatria has a small marsh patch; Hyksos absent (dossier starts -1650), Kerma holds a thin Nile strip up to Aswan; otherwise plausible.

Fifteenth Dynasty carries a lobe of Western Desert (Giza governorate, to 27.4 E) beyond the Delta and valley; Middle Kingdom's 1,051 leftover desert cells go to nobody (fine); Hyksos shown as purple scraps inside the Fifteenth's salmon (two dossiers, one state); Abydos and Sixteenth Dynasty blobs placed at Abydos/Thebes.

Hittites (Hattusa to Kayseri-Maras), Yamhad, Qatna (with the Palmyra circle), Arzawa look plausible; Assyria/Babylonia/Elam border plausible; the Sealand rectangle again swamps the Arabian desert and Elam's Khuzestan.
Xia (Shanxi-Henan), Sanxingdui, Jeulmun, Jomon: no stray cells or holes; fine as drawn.
Sealand now the marsh, Dhi-Qar, Basra, Uruk, Nippur and Isin (179 cells); Elam keeps Khuzestan; no conflict left between them.
Western Desert lobe gone; Fifteenth Dynasty is the Delta, Avaris, Memphis and the valley to Cusae (200 cells).

issues.what: First Sealand dynasty keyframe -1700 uses a box 42-50 E, 27-32.3 N (1,599 cells: Saudi desert, Kuwait, the Gulf, Khuzestan); the pages give the far-south province with pottery at Girsu, Uruk and Lagash 'but in no site north of that', Nippur conquered late in Samsu-iluna's reign. Replaced by the same region m1800-m1701 used for -1732 plus the Nippur and Isin circles of its events/0, so keyframe equals ledger.

Fifteenth Dynasty keyframe -1650 draws 'Lower Egypt minus Matruh' = 108 extra cells of the Giza Western Desert (Bahariya side, to 27.4 E) beyond the Cliopatria shape and Memphis; the page gives the Delta, Avaris and Memphis only, and the dossier's own keyframe -1600 for the same land has 202 cells, not 308. Cut by a loss-to-nobody event plus a matching keyframe override (no snap results).

Assyria / Babylonia size-rule conflict and Assyria snap at -1700 (145 cells: Salah ad-Din 81, Sulaymaniyah 29, Diyala 23): Assyria takes Cliopatria's -1700 hinterland from Babylonia's anchor. The Samsu-iluna page says only that 'within a few years after his death, Elam and Assyria had left from Babylon's orbit' and that Eshnunna's status is 'difficult to determine'; no page names Tigris or Diyala holders in 1700.

Babylonia keyframe -1700 snap (106 cells removed: Al-Anbar 70, Kermanshah 14, Wasit 12, +5; was 91 before m1800-m1701's patch): the anchor's Akkad-plus-Mari region is wider than Cliopatria's -1700 shape; no page dates the shrinkage beyond Assyria and Elam leaving the orbit within a few years of 1712.

Hittites keyframe -1650 snap (177 added: Kayseri 59, K. Maras 52, Adana 21; 76 removed: Corum, Kirikkale, Kirsehir): the found event is a 100 km circle round Hattusa, the keyframe is Cliopatria's 1600 shape. Hattusili I page: capital moved from Nesa (Kanesh, near Kultepe) to Hattusa, campaigns to Zalpa (year 1), Alalakh and Syria (year 2), Arzawa (year 3), 'extended the Hittite domain to the sea', reign c. 1650-1620; it names no Cilicia, Kizzuwatna or Taurus land and no cell-level extent.

Kerma / Middle Kingdom conflict at -1700 (71 cell-years, Aswan 55 and Northern Sudan 16, Kerma wins): the Kerma dossier has Lower Nubia from -1750, the Middle Kingdom dossier loses it in -1650. Second Intermediate Period page: the 13th Dynasty 'withdrew its garrisons' and 'the forts were reoccupied by the rising Nubian state of Kush', undated.

Abydos Dynasty / Sixteenth Dynasty conflict (38 cell-years, desert cells, Abydos wins) and the Sixteenth/Kerma 3 cells: small and the smaller state wins; dossiers already record the 1650-1600 (infobox) versus 1640-1620 (Second Intermediate Period page) dating.

Middle Kingdom ends in -1650: 1,051 cells of its Cliopatria shape (Western and Eastern Desert) go to nobody; the valley is split among the Fifteenth (Delta to Cusae), Abydos Dynasty, Sixteenth Dynasty (Thebes) and Kerma (Lower Nubia). Page: the 14th Dynasty held the Delta 'near Athribis ... and Bubastis', the 16th ruled 'the Theban region' from Hu to Edfu, the Hyksos/Egyptian border 'alternated between Beni Hasan and Asyut'. Gap between Asyut and Abydos left nobody's.
Hyksos and Fifteenth Dynasty are drawn as two states on the same land: purple scraps (31 cells, 8 pieces, plus a Sharuhen circle) inside the Fifteenth's 200-308 cells, 1,650-1,550 for both.

Contest fifteenth-dynasty-of-egypt / sixteenth-dynasty-of-egypt (87 cells from -1630) stays open at the window's end; it closes in -1582 in the dossiers. Page: the 15th 'eventually conquering Thebes itself', the 16th subsumed c. 1580.

East Asia (Xia, Sanxingdui, Jeulmun, Jomon), Indus, Americas, Tichitt, Qatna (with its Palmyra circle), Yamhad (18-cell snap), Arzawa, Minoan, Mycenaean: no strays, holes or jumps seen or found by component scan.
